$comment: Terrain kinds. The order is the terrain index stored in a map (index = position in this object), so only ever append. frame = atlas frame (data/atlas.json) of the terrain piece; tile = the cell's index in the terrain tilesets (see `tileset`); decor = how the view dresses the cell (trees on forest: one of treeVariants pictures with three trees, picked by a hash of the cell); seasonal = the season tint of seasons.json multiplies its colour; buildable = an ordinary building may stand here (a building's own `terrain` list overrides it); roadable = a road may be laid here.

tileset.$comment: The ground of the map is ONE isometric Tilemap (scripts/game/map_view.js) whose picture is one PNG per season, made by assets/src/make_terrain_tiles.py from the frames in assets/src/frames: do not edit the PNGs, edit the frames or this table and run the script again. Every cell of a PNG is tileSize pixels; the diamond's top corner is groundOffset below the cell's top edge (room for the trees). Tile numbers: the `tile` of each terrain kind; roadTile + the 4-bit neighbour mask (0..15) for a road piece; treeTile + 0..treeVariants-1 for a forest with trees (the plain forest tile is the one without trees, shown under a building). The seasonal tint is baked into the sand, grass, forest and tree pictures; water, rock and roads are the same in every season.
